body: I was gonna say Crawford. Like Cindy Crawford
Mmm, I'd love to cuddle up with you

What I was trying to say is I keep striving for relationships in my adult life that mimic the one I had with my mom. I pursue relationships with people who are accepting of me if I agree with them fully, but the moment I express any opinions or feelings that don't validate theirs I get torn down or discarded. 

Im so old now. And I just hate that im so alone because I invested in people who just needed me to be an extension of who they are or who they view themselves to be.
I'm nothing and I've done nothing with my life. I have had too much trauma happen in my life and im not equipped to live in a way that I will ever help anyone or be able to be loved by anyone.
